title: Hellhounds
description: Adds furious packs of hellhounds to the Nether.
body:
Hellhounds. Fiery wolves that fear nothing. Now they've moved into the Nether, traveling in packs across the desolate landscape. A hellhound will follow their alpha loyally, and can only be tamed when the alpha has been killed. But be wary! Alpha hellhounds are aggressive, and will sick the whole pack on you!

(Fabric only right now, Neoforge version coming soon!)
